profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Creative technologist with strong experience solving problems and building sophisticated web applications. Enjoy working with like-minded professionals dedicated to creativity, hard work, ingenuity and generally trying to get the very last ounce out of everything that we do in life.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Back in the nest. Might be here for a while.

positions.title: Wanderluster
positions.description:
Kept a promise to myself and took a year (and some) off to travel, primarily through parts of Europe and Asia. 

Europe - Croatia, Slovenia, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Netherlands, UK, Ireland
Asia - Thailand, Malaysia, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Singapore

Slightly procrastinated getting back to the real world. 😏

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Designed and developed technologies for the analytics platform for Google's largest display advertising clients and agencies.
